name: JSWorld Conference 2027
description: Amsterdam JavaScript conference, 10th and final edition
note: Conference + included workshop, live stream, English; price and early-bird not shown
dateNote: aggregators list Mar 12; official site and ticket page say Mar 19; Vue.js Amsterdam is Mar 18
details: One-day conference for senior JavaScript engineers, billed as the final edition at Theater Amsterdam. About 1,000 in-person attendees plus 3,000+ stream viewers. Speakers include Evan You, Tim Neutkens, Matteo Collina and Luca Mezzalira; themes: JavaScript in the age of AI and 10 years of JS. Ticket includes meals, an optional 'Code Review at Agent Scale' workshop and the afterparty; street address and prices not on the pages read.
